svg.title: Maple Home Workshop print collateral portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional graphic design portfolio concept for Maple Home Workshop, showing refined blank print collateral mockups and paper stocks. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
